rca of the issue: Root cause was Pydantic response model in contracts.py filtering out newly added fields (score_distribution, averages, emissions_by_scope) plus missing fallback for E/S/G score calculation when score_breakdown was absent. Fix: extended SupplierRankingEntry/SupplierRankingResponse contracts and added fallback E/S/G computation from question answers. Verified: all previously empty/zero charts now render with correct values.
